1.title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Attacks on Democratic Senate Candidates
1.summary: The president attacked three Democrats running for Senate this week with inaccurate claims to portray them as too extreme.

2.title: Six Nigerians accused of romance scams to be extradited to the US
2.summary: The six will face wire fraud and money-laundry charges in the US, South African police say.

3.title: Republicans Go All In on Trump
3.summary: Shane Goldmacher, one of our national political correspondents, looks at the Republican candidates who spoke this week at their party’s unusual midterm convention, called a “Trumpapalooza.” Some other vulnerable candidates avoided it because of President Trump’s unpopularity.

4.title: Houthis Seize Key Red Sea Island, Threatening Another Global Oil Route
4.summary: The militia captured the island in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a choke point for trade. Saudi Arabia also said it had shut down a critical oil pipeline after a drone attack launched from Iraq.

5.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
5.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis are also reported to have seized Perim - a strategic island on the major shipping route.

6.title: Six Nigerians accused of romance scams to be extradited to the US
6.summary: The six will face wire fraud and money-laundry charges in the US, South African police say.
